konu: Adverbs of Manner (slowly, quickly, carefully, well, hard, fast), Technology in Education & Comparing Routines
ciktilar: ENG.9.2.G2. Uses regular (-ly) and irregular (well, hard, fast) adverbs of manner with the Simple Present Tense to describe study activities.
ENG.9.2.R2. Explains how technology-supported education affects students' study routines and classroom collaboration.
ENG.9.2.W1. Compares a person's weekday and weekend routines using time expressions, frequency adverbs, and adverbs of manner.
hatirla: Adjectives describe nouns (a careful student), while adverbs of manner describe verbs and tell HOW an action is done (She listens carefully).
Most adverbs add '-ly' (slow → slowly, quick → quickly, easy → easily), but irregular adverbs do not take '-ly': good → well, hard → hard, fast → fast.

sorular.soru: Sıfatları (Adjectives) doğru durum zarfı (Adverb of Manner) biçimleri ve örnek kullanımlarıyla eşleştiriniz.
ciftler: listen to the teacher carefully in class

sorular.soru: Görseldeki durum zarfı kurallarına göre “Our teacher explains the grammar rules very ___, so we understand them ___.”
sorular.cozum: Her iki boşluk da fiilleri ('explains' ve 'understand') nitelediği için durum zarfı ('clearly' ve 'easily') kullanılmalıdır.

sorular.soru: “Ceren is a ___ (careful) reader; she reads all exam questions ___ (careful).” cümlesindeki boşlukları doğru biçimlerle tamamlayınız.
sorular.cevap: 1. boşluk reader ismini nitelediği için sıfat (careful).

sorular.soru: Durum zarfları (Adverbs of Manner) ve çalışma rutinleriyle ilgili ifadelerden doğru olanlara D, yanlış olanlara Y yazınız.

ifadeler.metin: Adverbs of manner describe how an action is done and usually come after the verb or object.
The adverb form of the adjective 'good' is 'goodly'.
To form the adverb of 'fast', we do not add '-ly'; it stays 'fast'.
Educational apps help students access study materials quickly and practise pronunciation easily.

sorular.soru: Sıfatları, durum zarfı (Adverb of Manner) karşılıklarını ve cümle içi görevlerini tabloda tamamlayınız.

satirlar.b: Students study quietly in the school library

satirlar: We learn new vocabulary easily with flashcards

satirlar.b: Jacob organises his study time very well

satirlar: She types fast on the computer during IT class

sorular.soru: Görseldeki günlük rutin akışına göre başarılı bir öğrencinin hafta içi çalışma adımlarını sabahtan akşama sıraya diziniz.
ogeler: She wakes up early at 07:00 on weekdays and gets ready for school quickly
She attends her morning classes on time and listens to her teachers carefully
In the afternoon, she works collaboratively with her classmates in the science lab
In the evening, she revises her daily notes quietly and goes to bed early

sorular.soru: Görseldeki düzensiz zarflar tablosuna göre hangi cümlede düzensiz durum zarfı (irregular adverb) DOĞRU kullanılmıştır?
secenekler: Akio studies hardly for his exams.
Jacob plays chess well and solves puzzles fast.
Students run fastly in the gym.
sorular.cozum: 'good' sıfatının zarfı 'well', 'fast' sıfatının zarfı ise 'fast'tir ('goodly' ve 'fastly' yoktur; 'hardly' ise 'neredeyse hiç' demektir).

sorular.soru: Cümlelerdeki boşlukları uygun durum zarflarıyla tamamlayınız.

cumleler.metin: Please read the exam instructions ___ before you start answering.
Arda speaks English very ___ because he practises every day.
Please study ___ in the library; don't disturb other students.

sorular.soru: Sınıf içi soruları ve çalışma ifadelerini uygun yanıtlarıyla eşleştiriniz.
ciftler: How do you study for your exams?
I revise my notes carefully and repeat words regularly.
It helps us access materials quickly and interactively.
How does your sister speak English?
She speaks English fluently and very well.

sorular.soru: Hafta içi/hafta sonu rutinleri ve dil yapılarıyla ilgili ifadelerden doğru olanlara D, yanlış olanlara Y yazınız.

ifadeler.metin: After 'am / is / are', we use an adjective (e.g., She is careful), not an adverb of manner.
When adding '-ly' to adjectives ending in '-y' (like 'easy' or 'happy'), '-y' changes to '-ily'.
Technology-supported education stops students from collaborating in groups.
We use 'On weekdays' for Monday to Friday, and 'At weekends' for Saturday and Sunday.
